system.description:
Your mastery of your spark effects even your powerful skills. When you use Elemental Mastery, your next Skill gains a new form and effects based on which element you channel.

  • Lightning: It deals extra damage equal to [Arcana], and if a skill would cause a target to begin Burning, they instead become Shocked.
  • Ice: If a skill would move a target, they instead take extra damage equal to [Arcana] and if the target was Soaked they become Frozen instead.
  • Metal: All damage done becomes [Physical], and on attack rolls of Good or higher, damaged targets gain 1 Bleeding Wound.
  • Pressure: If a skill would move a target, they take additional damage equal to [Arcana] and are moved 2 additional Spaces.
